Country: Bangladesh

RFP No: CWSIP/W-1: Lot-1 and Lot-2
Issued on: 12 July, 2026
1. The Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh (GoB) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Chattogram Water Supply Improvement Project (CWSIP), to be implemented by Chattogram Water Supply and Sewerage Authority (CWASA), an autonomous entity of the GoB, and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Design, Construction, Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning for System Improvement and DMA Formation, Lot 1: MOHARA Water Supply System, Lot 2: Modunaghat and Kalurghat Water Supply System. For this contract, the Borrower shall process the payments using the Direct Payment disbursement method, as defined in the World Bank’s Disbursement Guidelines for Investment Project Financing
2. The Chattogram Water Supply and Sewerage Authority (CWASA) now invites sealed Proposals from the eligible Proposers for Design, Construction, Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning for System Improvement and DMA Formation, Lot 1: MOHARA Water Supply System, Lot 2: Modunaghat and Kalurghat Water Supply System. The works include: Laying of new HDPE and DI pipes, laying new service connection pipes, establishment of DMAs, new reservoir and pumping station, etc. The works under both lots are located in Chattogram. The estimated completion period each of the two lots is 1260 days. More details are provided in the RFP documents.
3. Proposers may submit Proposal for one or both lots, as further defined in the RFP Document.
4. The procurement will be conducted through international competitive procurement using Request for Proposals (RFP) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” Fifth Edition, September, 2023. (“Procurement Regulations”), and is open to all eligible Proposers as defined in the Procurement Regulations.
5. Interested eligible Proposers may obtain further information from Md. Rejaul Ahsan Chowdhury, Project Director, Chattogram Water Supply Improvement Project (CWSIP), Chattogram WASA, email: rejaulahsan87@gmail.com and inspect the RFP Document during office hours 0900 to 1600 hours Local Bangladesh Time (GMT + 6 Hrs) at the address given below. A read-only copy of the RFP documents will also be uploaded in www.ctg-wasa.org.bd .
6. A complete set of the RFP Document comprising four (4) volumes, Volume 1 (Part 1- Request for Proposal Procedures and Part 3- Conditions of Contract and Contract Forms), Volume 2A and 2B (Employer’s Requirement), Volume 3A and 3B (Conceptual Drawing) and Volume 4-Supplementary Information in English may be purchased by eligible Proposers upon the submission of a written application to the address below and upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of USD 200 or BDT 24,000. The bank transaction reference number should be explicitly mentioned. The method of payment will be electronic wire transfer or cash deposit to the Employer’s Bank account specified below. Within 3 working days of receipt of the payment in the bank account, CWASA shall issue the Hard Copy of the RFP document which the prospective Proposers are advised to collect from the address below. The soft copy of the same will also be sent through reply email. In case of discrepancy between hard and soft copy, the hard copy shall prevail.
7. A single-stage, two envelope RFP process will be used, and the Proposal will consist of (i) the Technical Part, without any reference to prices; and (ii) the Financial Part, as detailed in the RFP Document. The Technical and Financial Parts of the Proposals shall be submitted simultaneously in two separate sealed envelopes.
8. The Proposal, both the Technical Part and the Financial Part, must be delivered to the address below on or before 14.00 Hours, Local Bangladesh Time (GMT + 6 Hrs) on 15 November 2026. Electronic Procurement will not be permitted. Late Proposals will be rejected. The Technical Part of the Proposals will be publicly opened in the presence of the Proposers’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend at the address below on 14.15 Hours, Local Bangladesh Time (GMT+6Hrs) on 15 November 2026. The Financial Part shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Employer until the second public opening of the Financial Part, following the evaluation of the Technical Part of the Proposals.
9. All Proposals must be accompanied by a (i) Proposal Security of USD 700,000 or BDT 85 million or equivalent in any freely convertible currency for Lot 1; USD 1,100,000 or BDT 134 million or equivalent in any freely convertible currency for Lot 2 in favour of Managing Director, Chattogram Water Supply and Sewearge Authority and (ii) Local Labour Method Statement.

Assignment Title: Selection of an NGO for Monitoring, Evaluation and Operational Review (Spot Checks) for both Host Community and FDMN activities.
Reference No.: SD-16
The Government of Bangladesh is implementing the Inclusive Services and Opportunities for Host Communities and Displaced Rohingya Population (ISO) Project with World Bank financing. The Project Development Objective is to improve access to human capital services for vulnerable host communities and displaced Rohingya populations. Component 3, implemented by the Department of Social Services (DSS) under the Ministry of Social Welfare (MoSW), supports social care, child protection, and economic empowerment interventions for the Host Communities and Forcibly Displaced Myanmar Nationals (FDMN) in Chattogram Division. Under this assignment, DSS intends to conduct independent Monitoring, Evaluation, and Operational Reviews (Spot Checks) to assess whether child protection and economic empowerment interventions under the ISO Project are being implemented in accordance with approved guidelines / procedures and agreed protocols. The assignment will verify operational performance, beneficiary targeting, service delivery quality, use of systems among others and assess progress toward intended outputs and outcomes.
Purpose
The Monitoring, Evaluation and Operational Review (Spot Checks) will be conducted in a representative sample of locations where ISO Project interventions are being implemented for both Host Community (Chattogram Division) and FDMN populations (Camps in Cox’s Bazar and Bhasan Char). The assignment will cover both Child Protection and Economic Empowerment interventions. The NGO will be responsible for conducting independent monitoring, evaluation and operational reviews to assess operational performance, beneficiary targeting, use of digital systems, adequacy and capacity of human resources, quality of service delivery Relevant indicators will be drawn from the ISO Project Results Framework, as applicable. The assignment will be implemented over Eighteen (18) months.
Objectives
The objective of this assignment is to conduct independent Monitoring, Evaluation, and Operational Reviews (Spot Checks) to assess whether child protection and economic empowerment interventions under the ISO Project are being implemented in accordance with approved guidelines / procedures and agreed protocols. The assignment will verify operational performance, beneficiary targeting, service delivery quality, use of systems among others and assess progress toward intended outputs and outcomes.
The assignment will also involve an outcome evaluation of the social care and economic empowerment interventions in terms of beneficiary households’ progress across a set of relevant socio-economic / welfare indicators. Findings from the operational reviews and outcome evaluation would also need to be analyzed from a gender and social inclusion perspective, identifying any differential experiences or gaps affecting women and vulnerable groups, and will provide practical recommendations to support corrective actions and continuous improvement.
The shortlisting criteria are:
The NGO shall meet the following minimum qualification and experience requirements:
- At least 10 years of relevant experience in monitoring, evaluation, operational reviews, or spot checks of large-scale development programs, preferably in Bangladesh or the region.
- Experience in applying participatory and verification-based approaches to beneficiary targeting and service delivery assessment.
- Strong understanding of social protection, livelihoods, poverty reduction, and community-based programs in Bangladesh and similar socio-economic contexts, including experience with government led programs and demonstrated experience with World Bank- or development partner-financed projects.
- Proven experience in designing and implementing digitally enabled quantitative and qualitative data collection (using CAPI devices configured with KOBO Toolbox, Survey CTO and other similar platforms etc.), including household surveys, focus group discussions, key informant interviews, and field observations.
- Demonstrated capacity to configure and deploy Bangla-language digital instruments using CAPI / mobile platforms, offline data capture in low-connectivity locations, and routine data quality checks such as back-checks and spot re-interviews.
- Capacity to maintain a secure database for storing, managing and analyzing all data collected under the assignment, with respondent-level unique identifiers and appropriate access, backup and confidentiality controls.
- Strong analytical, conceptual, and reporting capacity, with demonstrated ability to produce clear, evidence based, and actionable reports.
- Demonstrated capacity to analyze quantitative and qualitative data using standard analysis software (i.e., Stata, R, SPSS, Python etc.)
- Adequate organizational capacity to manage multi location field operations and deploy digitally equipped field teams across multiple districts and camps.
- Demonstrated experience in monitoring or evaluating child protection, social service workforce, case management, or gender-based violence prevention and response programs.
- Demonstrated experience of field data collection in humanitarian or fragility, conflict and violence settings, preferably in the Rohingya camps in Cox's Bazar and Bhasan Char or similar refugee contexts.
- Demonstrated commitment to safeguarding, with an established Code of Conduct and experience of implementing / adopting Sexual Exploitation and Abuse and Sexual Harassment (SEA/SH) prevention and response protocols in field-based programs.
- The NGO shall also have documented data protection and confidentiality policies for personally identifiable and case-related data, including data relating to children and survivors.

We wszystkich takich sytuacjach Wykonawca może zaoferować równoważne materiały, produkty o co najmniej takich samych parametrach technicznych oraz jakościowych. Przez równoważność produktu rozumie się zaoferowanie produktu, którego parametry techniczne zastosowanych materiałów, wydajność, trwałość oraz jakość jest nie gorsza od jakości materiałów, produktów opisanych w SWZ. 7. Wykonawca, który powołuje się na rozwiązania równoważne, jest zobowiązany wykazać, że oferowane przez niego rozwiązanie spełnia wymagania określone przez Zamawiającego. W takim przypadku Wykonawca załącza do oferty wykaz rozwiązań równoważnych wraz z jego opisem lub normami. 8. Finland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Uusiomateriaaliarviointi 2027-2029 (optiot 2030 ja 2031)

Uusiomateriaaliarviointi 2027-2029 (optiot 2030 ja 2031)

Väyläviraston ja elinvoimakeskusten hankkeissa käytettäville uusiomateriaaleille on tehtävä teknisen soveltuvuuden arviointi. Ohjeen Uusiomateriaalien käyttö väylärakentamisessa mukaan uusiomateriaalien käyttöön Väyläviraston ja elinvoimakeskusten väylähankkeilla tarvitaan joko Väyläviraston yleinen tai hankekohtainen teknisen soveltuvuuden arviointi. Teknisen soveltuvuuden arviointi on väylähankkeen tilaajana asettama vaatimus, jonka tavoitteena on varmistua rakenteiden toimivuudesta ja materiaalien turvallisesta käytöstä. Väylävirastossa toimii uusiomateriaalien teknisen soveltuvuuden arvioinneista vastaava asiantuntijaryhmä. Tämä hankinta koskee kyseisen arviointityön tueksi hankittavaa asiantuntijapalvelua vuosille 2027-2029 sekä optiona vuosille 2030 ja 2031. Työ sisältää ohjeen "Uusiomateriaalien käyttö väylärakentamisessa" mukaisiin yleisiin ja hankekohtaisiin teknisen soveltuvuuden arviointeihin liittyvät työt, kuten: - yleisten ja hankekohtaisten arviointien tuki ja niihin liittyvä yhteistyö - neuvottelut materiaalitoimittajien kanssa - arviointipyyntöjen aineistojen läpikäynnit, arviointikirjeen valmistelu sekä arviointien viimeistely ja arkistointi - uusiomateriaaliryhmän kokousten valmistelu ja sihteerinä toimiminen Tarjouskilpailun mahdolliset eturistiriidat arvioidaan julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista annetun lain (1379/2016, erityisesti lain 3, 66 ja 81 §) mukaisesti, ottaen huomioon myös tarjoajan alihankkija- ja konsernisuhteet. Palveluntuottajaksi valitaan yksi toimittaja. Hankinta on kuvattu tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.
